events.title: Thought Leadership Breakfast Series: Beyond the balance sheet: Driving future success and growth through accounting
events.location: Collider, UniSC Innovation, University of the Sunshine Coast
events.description: Join IML, UniSC, and the 4556 Chamber for an engaging session exploring how leaders can use financial and accounting insights to strengthen business performance. Learn how to interpret key financial information, ask the right questions and use financial data to support strategic decision-making.

events.title: The Future of Sport
events.description: Come along to the UniSC Arena for a night with key players, who work on and off the sporting field. Joining them are our expert teaching staff to discuss all things sport­ – a global and fast-moving industry – and where the future is heading, including right here in our regions.
